## Invoice-Lines BACKFILL (one-time)
Loops MONTH BY MONTH from `backfillFrom` to `backfillTo` in **Config**, pulling posted
customer invoices + credit notes from `account.invoice.report`, upserting on `line_id`.

**Before running:** replace `__SUPABASE_URL__` and `__SERVICE_ROLE_KEY__` in Config with
the NEW project's values (jxihpdjyquyttscqzcid). The service_role key never leaves n8n.

**Test ONE month first** - set backfillFrom 2026-06-01 / backfillTo 2026-07-01, run it,
check the row count, then widen to full history and run again. Upsert makes re-runs safe.

The Odoo node has **Always Output Data ON**. Without it a month with no invoices returns
nothing and n8n HALTS the entire workflow mid-backfill.

Credit notes arrive NEGATIVE and are stored that way, so returns net out on every sum.
